Firefighters from the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) - Makati City rescued a dog that was trapped in the waterway in Barangay Guadalupe Nuevo, Makati City.

The BFP personnel on duty conducted an animal rescue operation along the creek of San Jose.

Courtesy: BFP NCR Makati City
